links.comparator_used: No direct comparator; AI ran silently with outputs withheld from care and predictions were compared with radiologist report labels and expert review (no retrospective-validation or go-live arm)
links.outcome: Diagnostic performance of AI for triaging normal chest radiographs and clinically significant misses
links.effect: 63,083 radiographs; 97% sensitivity, 35% specificity, 57% PPV, 94% NPV; 31 clinically significant AI misses (estimated miss rate 0.05%); 18.5% of examinations concordant normal and potentially deprioritized
links.tradeoff: Low specificity: 80% of examinations were classified abnormal. Missed findings were mostly subtle or overlapping lesions.
links.quote: Expert review of discrepant cases, after exclusion of 412 natural language processing labeling errors, identified 31 clinically significant AI misses, corresponding to an estimated clinically significant miss rate of 0.05%.
